title: Serpentshrine Cavern
body: Serpentshrine Cavern is the deepest hold of Coilfang Reservoir, a vast flooded cavern beneath Serpent Lake and the seat of Lady Vashj, matron of the Coilfang naga. Here the water drawn in from the bogs gathers, and honor guards drive the workers at the pumps, boasting that soon all of Draenor's water will be theirs. Greyheart Broken serve the naga, Tidewalker murlocs crowd one shore, and Vashj's lords hold the outer chambers.

parts.body: Hydross the Unstable, a lord of water, purifies the tainted spirits that come to him, but drawn out of his cleansing field the poison takes him at once.
sources: zones/serpentshrine_cavern.txt (map 548: area 3607 only)

parts.body: Fathom-Lord Karathress kept a Broken, Seer Olum, caged at the edge of his chamber. When the fathom-lord died the cage swung open.
sources: zones/serpentshrine_cavern.txt (map 548: area 3607 only)

parts.body: Morogrim Tidewalker, giant of the sea and lord of the murlocs here, died with words that meant nothing to those who heard them: great currents of Ageon.
sources: zones/serpentshrine_cavern.txt (map 548: area 3607 only)

title: Leotheras the Blind
body: Leotheras the Blind is a blood elf demon hunter held banished in Serpentshrine Cavern by three Greyheart spellbinders. He fights with twin blades, but he is not alone in his body: from time to time a demon takes him over, mocking the trifling elf it has cast aside. Near the end the elf cannot contain it, and it tears free as a shadow of its own.
sources: creature_template 21215 (display 20514, BloodElfMale); fixed spawn 153139, map 548 only
smart_scripts 21806 (Greyheart Spellbinder: Green Beam out of combat, Banish in combat, on death checks the others; Leotheras wakes when none is left)

boss_leotheras_the_blind.cpp (passive and kneeling until freed; SAY_AGGRO Finally, my banishment ends!; dual wield and Whirlwind; Metamorphosis with SAY_SWITCH_TO_DEMON Be gone, trifling elf. I am in control now!; Insidious Whisper with SAY_INNER_DEMONS We all have our demons....)

title: Lady Vashj
body: Lady Vashj is the matron of the Coilfang naga. Long ago she was one of the Highborne of ancient Kalimdor, a handmaiden to Queen Azshara, and she rose from the sea with her naga when Illidan Stormrage called on them; she has served him ever since. Water is life, she says, a rare thing in Outland that her people alone shall control, and the time has come for the Highborne to retake their rightful place in the world.

parts.body: She made her last stand at the heart of her platform behind a barrier fed by four shield generators, and died with an apology to her master: Lord Illidan, I am sorry.
sources: creature_template 21212 (subname Coilfang Matron, display 20748); fixed spawn 153195, map 548 only
